You just need to start cooking. Checkout places like /v/food or /v/cooking for other people's success. Take a look at what your friends are making. Get recipes off of boxes and cans. Cooking is easy, overcoming fear of the unknown is hard.

Saltedtv.com is an online video cooking school. It usually costs 9.99/month but there are often discount codes floating around online.

There are also a lot 9f websites with free recipes and some cooking instruction, like Epicurious.com and Foodtv.com.

You can also usually find a lot of cookbooks and cooking instruction manuals at the library.
